title: Private Equity Wire: Luke Sarsfield on investing through disruption
summary: Ridgepost Capital Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Luke Sarsfield recently sat down with Jack Arrowsmith of Private Equity Wire at IPEM Global to discuss the evolving private markets landscape and investing through disruption.
body_markdown:
Ridgepost Capital Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Luke Sarsfield recently sat down with Jack Arrowsmith of Private Equity Wire at IPEM Global to discuss the evolving private markets landscape and investing through disruption.


Luke highlighted why the middle market can offer resilience during periods of uncertainty through a broader opportunity set, lower leverage, and greater exit optionality. He also shared perspectives on trends shaping private markets, including AI adoption and the expansion of private wealth distribution.
